members.name: industry_group_reversion_v1
members.universe: 6 industry groups: private banks (5), PSU banks (5), IT services (4), generic pharma (4), cement (4), auto OEMs (4)
members.thesis: Within tightly correlated industry sub-groups (e.g., private banks, PSU banks, IT services, generic pharma), individual stock returns tend to revert to the group mean within the same trading day. When a stock deviates >15 bps from its industry group average return, the deviation is likely noise (ord
entry_long: stock has no specific news today
entry_short: stock has no specific news today
members.exit_target: stock_deviation reverts to 0 (stock returns to group average)
members.exit_stop: deviation_zscore extends to ±3.0 (deviation widening — likely news-driven)
filters: no VIX filter (intra-group reversion works across vol regimes)
skip first 15 min (group relationships establishing) and last 15 min
divergent stock volume > 50th percentile of its typical volume
no trend filter (relative reversion is trend-independent)
weaknesses: Stock-specific news (analyst upgrade/downgrade, management commentary, deal wins) can cause legitimate divergence that doesn't revert. The 'no news' filter is imperfect.
Within-group correlation is not constant — on result season days, correlations drop as individual earnings drive stocks, reducing signal reliability.
Equal-weighted group averages may not be appropriate when one stock dominates the group by market cap (e.g., HDFC Bank in private banks).

members.name: basket_spread_mean_reversion_v1
members.thesis: A basket of 5 highly correlated private bank stocks (HDFCBANK, ICICIBANK, KOTAKBANK, AXISBANK, INDUSINDBK) tends to move together. When one stock's intraday return deviates by > 2 SD from the basket's average return, it reverts. This is a more robust version of pairs trading because the basket reduc
filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
outlier stock must have normal volume (volume > 50% of 20-bar avg)
weaknesses: Single-leg trade (not hedged against basket) so directional risk remains
Stock-specific news (e.g., NPA announcement for one bank) causes permanent divergence, not mean reversion
Only 5 stocks in the basket — limited trade frequency; maybe 1-2 signals per day
members.prior_art: Basket relative value trading — common on institutional stat arb desks. Indian private banks are a known pair group.
